# Ditto

The Ditto Flutter SDK is an edge sync platform allowing devices to synchronize data with or without an internet connection.

For more info, go to <https://ditto.com/link/docs>

## Platforms

| Platform | Supported   |
|----------|-------------|
| iOS      | Yes         |
| Android  | Yes         |
| Web      | Yes         |
| MacOS    | Planned     |
| Windows  | Planned     |
| Linux    | Planned     |

## Installation

- Follow the install guide at <https://ditto.com/link/sdk-latest-install-guides-flutter>.
